text:
Alex: Quick sweep — INC-812 postmortem actions ready. Please ack ownership for any item you own and confirm due date. Doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-812

Morgan: Taking "monitoring alert thresholds" item. Due EOD Wed 2024-04-03. @ops-bot can you add a ticket in the tracker?

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-812-5 assigned to Morgan, due 2024-04-03.

Sudha: I can own "canary rollback playbook" but need infra help. ETA next Tue 2024-04-09. @Liam can you verify LB config?

Liam: On it — will validate LB config this afternoon, pinging eng-infra for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/452

Rachel: I own "release notes + comms". Need final action statements from others by Mon 2024-04-01.

Alex: Noted. Two blockers: (1) cross-region failover test window (ops) (2) legal signoff on customer comms for EU customers.

ops-bot: Scheduled failover test for 2024-04-05 02:00 UTC. Coordinator: @Maya (eng-sre).

Maya: I'll coordinate the test and send calendar invite. Need app owners to confirm readiness by 2024-04-03.

Sudha: FYI, my rollback docs reference the kv-cache PR; need merge first. @Liam any ETA on merge?

Liam: PR has one outstanding CR from @Nora, pinged her.

Nora: Reviewing now, will finish by EOD.

Morgan: If the merge slips, can we do a temporary config patch? @Alex thoughts?

Alex: We can, but prefer merge. If blocked, Morgan file a hotfix ticket and tag eng-oncall.

Morgan: Will do.

Rachel: For comms, do we have a canned line for customers impacted by higher token latency? draft: "Some customers experienced intermittent latency due to an autoscaling edge case..." Thoughts?

Alex: fine, add "no data exfiltration" line. Legal to review.

ops-bot: Legal review requested for comms doc (ticket #COMMS-219).

Liam: Quick note — quantization rollout for canary model scheduled 2024-04-07; could affect latency numbers in the postmortem. Flagging for monitoring.

Alex: Great catch. Add that to postmortem appendix.

Sudha: Ok all — I'll update the doc with owners + dates. tagging for final check: @Alex @Morgan @Liam @Rachel

Morgan: Acked. :thumbsup:

Nora: Done with CR, PR merged.

ops-bot: PR merged: #452 — closing dependency blocker.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — if anything slips, reopen here.
